original.description: Studio portrait of General Sir Horace Smith-Dorrien in service dress, by the Washington studio Harris & Ewing.
original.archive: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; Permission "PD-US"). Harris & Ewing photographs at the Library of Congress carry no known restrictions.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — BEF khaki service dress is documented, and this is the best-resolution portrait in the batch.

caption: General Sir Horace Smith-Dorrien, who took command of II Corps of the BEF four days before Mons and turned to fight at Le Cateau on 26 August 1914 against Sir John French’s wishes.
credit: Original photograph: Harris & Ewing, between 1913 and 1917; Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Smith-Dorrien is one of the larger gaps in the cast: Le Cateau is his decision and the pack has had no face for it.
